Checked: `sh -c` prints two lines and `bash -c` prints the literal `\\n`.","fix":"Use `printf '#!/bin/sh\\njust pre-commit\\n' > .git/hooks/pre-commit` and the same for pre-push. On macOS, bsdtar *creating* an archive is what adds AppleDouble `._*` entries for files with xattrs such as com.apple.provenance, and this is the graph fixture the finding names. The diff adds COPYFILE_DISABLE only to two *extract* calls in callisto-cli tests (`tar -xOf` to stdout and `tar -x` from a git archive), where it does nothing. 76:## Rules
77-
78-- Before each WP: `git fetch`; re-verify the plan's finding against current main (other sessions merge in between). If another session already owns the WP's branch, skip to your next WP.
79-- Work in a named worktree per WP (EnterWorktree), branched off origin/main. No stacks. Each worktree builds into its own `target/`, so builds in different worktrees run in parallel with no lock; never run two builds in the same worktree.
80-- Build budget, exported once per session: `CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0` and `CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0` (debug info is most of each `target/`; dropping it cuts disk and link time), `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=$(( $(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN) / 4 ))` and the same value for nextest `--test-threads`, so four builders share the CPU.
81-- Mutation testing runs in place in the WP worktree after committing: `cargo mutants --in-place --in-diff <diff>`; it reuses the worktree's `target/` instead of copying the tree.
82-- Start independent pieces early in their own worktrees: Session 1 runs G's `pre.json` reader/writer (`model/format/pre.rs`) as a subagent with `isolation: "worktree"` while it works on F1; Session 2 ships J's twine environment change (`runner.rs`) first. Only the parts that touch shared files wait for their chain.
83-- Start the reviewer subagent as soon as the diff is final, in parallel with the gate and mutation run; it reads, it never builds.
84-- When a WP's PR is open and green, `rm -rf <worktree>/target`; after merge, remove the worktree and its local branch.
85-- Fix the root cause by the first rung that works: type or private constructor, exhaustive match, existing lint, one test at the real boundary. Write that test first. Delete checks the type makes redundant. Fix siblings in the same PR.
86-- Specs, ADRs and docs/architecture change in the same PR as behaviour.
87-- Gate by exit code, unsandboxed in the worktree: `just pre-push && just lint && just doc-check && just test`, then `cargo mutants --in-diff` on the WP's Rust diff with zero missed (an equivalent mutant gets one line in the PR body).
88-- Design-heavy WPs (L, E, Q): first spawn one Opus subagent (general-purpose, model opus) with the plan's finding and root-cause row; it returns a short design (types, signatures, call sites to migrate, the boundary test). Implement against it yourself.
89-- One fresh-context reviewer per PR (general-purpose, model opus) given only the diff and the finding. Apply what holds up.
